newsitem.title: USA: Zilog sees Q3 earnings "in line" with Q2.
newsitem.headline: Zilog sees Q3 earnings "in line" with Q2.

text.p: Semiconductor maker Zilog Inc said Monday it believes its third quarter results will generally be in line with its lower second quarter results.

Zilog, which today announced an agreement to be acquired by Texas Pacific Group, a private investment firm, said its second quarter net income fell 62 percent from a year earlier, to $4.7 million from $12.4 million. Earnings per share fell to $0.23 from $0.60.
Net sales for the second quarter were down 16.6 percent, to $71.3 million from $85.5 million a year ago.
Zilog said the second quarter results were impacted by "continued difficult industry conditions."
